commit_clusters.dcca3059eed5: insn-tablegen (RISCVInstrInfoXssr.td: SPseudoPush mayLoad 0->1, SPseudoPop mayStore 0->1; required by TableGen pattern inference once the intrinsics have unknown memory effects; builds on its own)
commit_clusters.15d5bff0e632: intrinsics (IntrinsicsRISCVXsnitch.td: drop IntrReadMem from int_riscv_ssr_pop, IntrWriteMem from int_riscv_ssr_push)

root_cause: Upstream e5c7cde5c812 '[NFC][TableGen] Refactor getIntrinsicFnAttributeSet (#106587)' replaced the fn-attribute gate '(ME != unknown && !hasSideEffects) || !canThrow || ...' (llvmorg-19.1.7 IntrinsicEmitter.cpp:595) with hasFnAttributes() using getEffectiveME(Int) != unknown. Intrinsics with IntrReadMem/IntrWriteMem + IntrHasSideEffects + Throws previously got no attributes; since 20 they get memory(read)/memory(write). IR passes ignore IntrHasSideEffects. Fork code relying on the old behaviour: 97efefdcc54e 'Move our own intrinsics to dedicated td files' (comment: Throws keeps push/pop in loops).
fix_summary: ssr.pop/ssr.push now have unknown memory effects (no memory property), like upstream int_xcore_in/int_xcore_out (IntrinsicsXCore.td:42,47 @ llvmorg-20.1.8). Their IR attributes are again identical to ref-18/port-19 (none). Pseudos get mayLoad=mayStore=1 as TableGen infers for XCore IN_2r/OUT_2r; hasSideEffects=1 was already set so machine code is unchanged.

attribute_audit.method: All 179 fork intrinsics (IntrinsicsRISCVXpulp.td + IntrinsicsRISCVXsnitch.td, from llvm-tblgen --dump-json) declared in logs/20-F022/decls.ll, printed with opt -S of each toolchain, compared with logs/20-F022/cmp.py (fn attrs + param attrs).

ref18_vs_int20_differences.why: each pop advances the input stream; memory(read) let LICM hoist and EarlyCSE merge pops

each push advances the output stream and its target address depends on stream state set by ssr setup; memory(write) claims the effect is independent of state. No miscompile was observed for push at O2 (not hoisted/merged since writes stay ordered), fixed together with pop to restore the ref-18 model and because the pseudo flags are shared in shape; report-only alternative would have been to keep IntrWriteMem.

attribute_audit.unchanged: the other 177 fork intrinsics have identical attributes in ref-18, port-19, int-20 and after this change (0 differences). Those with IntrNoMem+IntrHasSideEffects (SSR setup/read/write/enable/disable/barrier, SDMA start/stat/wait, Xpulp side-effecting builtins) still map to unknown memory in the emitter (getEffectiveME), so they are unaffected.
